g.title: Store, withRecordSnapshot, executeTargetedStore, and executeRecordStore coordinate snapshots, validation, writer exclusion, receipt preparation, publication, and exact journal recovery.
RecordFiles implements guarded reads and hashes, exclusive creation, temporary-file replacement, directory/file synchronization, and bounded removal.

constructMutation transforms an explicit request and supplied before-state into complete candidate writes and effects using source-span edits; the caller supplies stored content and Store performs publication.
Selects the supported stored format independently of advanced transport schemas and dispatches candidate/preservation validation.
Loads the stored v3 JSON schema and supplies record, set, and preservation validators through createRecordFormat.
Builds factual observations and identities from the supplied record set and reader.
The inspectSubjects helper uses RecordFiles reads/hashes for declared subjects; admission and result selection in the same file belong to MOD-010.
